reviews.author: Pamela

reviews.title: good flavor
reviews.body: it costs too much. it has a mild coffee flavor. I normally like a bolder flavor, still, this one has that coffee cherry addition that I think is the key to the taste I like about it.I don't think this is actually organic as the brand is claiming. there are none of the credentials that you can rely on with that claim. the only accreditation is the nongmo label. just something to think about when you're paying for what is supposed to be a higher quality organic product.does it do what it claims? I'm awake, but not jittery. that's all I can say.would I buy again? if it's on sale, yes.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2026
reviews.author: CaviKween

reviews.title: Great Organic Coffee Option
reviews.body: Originally received a bag of Laird coffee as a gift and enjoyed it so much that I purchased another bag. Was worried that I would not like the taste but, found that it is not as acidic as normal coffee and I enjoy the taste. I like a cup in the afternoon and that I get a better boost of energy. It's a great organic coffee option for the price.

reviews.title: Not tea your drinking...maybe a little
reviews.body: Starting what most of us want in the morning is coffee to wake us up, focus blend it does have coffee organic Arabica coffee also Coffee Cherry Powder, Organic Lions Mane Mushroom extract and Rhodiola Rosea extract sounds like tea.What those teas ingredients add is botanicals and adaphogens, adaphogens helps your body to better manage stress and anxiety along with botanicals that are medicinal therapeutic properties to help with fatigue, now comes the coffee cherry powder adding more antioxidants and nutrients other parts of the world use coffee cherry powder brewed as a beverage.I still can go out with friends to a coffee house, I love coffee, I can feel the difference and I do like that, but I really try to stick to mornings at home drinking Laid coffee and they have different flavors and strengths it gives energy but it’s different I feel better I think that is tea part kicking in.When I make my morning coffee and drink it I don’t think of tea, it tastes like a smooth cup of coffee that helps me to wake up later I can get to sleep much easier.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 26, 2022
reviews.author: wendy

reviews.title: Just tastes bad and over-roasted
reviews.body: I couldn't finish the first cup. They say it's medium roast but it's definitely on the darker side and it simply just tastes bad. If you're used to stuff like folgers maybe you'll be fine with it, but if you get local roasts and stuff like that, this is not going to cut it.
